_comment: Empty values are placeholders. ProductionSecretValidator gates startup if Vault has not provided values for required keys. See docs/ops/vault-key-rotation-runbook.md.

Backup._comment: Directory MUST be a mounted persistent volume in K8s (/backups is ephemeral otherwise — backups vanish on pod restart). See docs/ops/backup-restore-runbook.md.

Email._comment: SMTP relay for alert notifications. Host/Password come from Vault (Email__Host, Email__Password). Not in ProductionSecretValidator.RequiredKeys on purpose: a deployment that never uses an EMAIL alert rule must still boot. An EMAIL rule that breaches while Host is empty logs Critical and does not deliver — see AlertEvaluationJob.
